source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Sabotage through hardware/software
affected_asset_selectors: Ground: Design, development, and quality assurance & Assembly & Satellite Control Centre
description: Threats resulting from connection of unauthorized rogue hardware and software, such as USB sticks, unauthorized applications, etc. may endanger the integrity, confidentiality and availability of satellite components. They can be perpetrated as a result of intentional, targeted human intervention or even on the orbit itself (docking of another satellite).

projection.lifecycle_rule: ET-P-LC-01 (legacy tuple L field; Annex C has no lifecycle column)

derivation_provenance.note: candidate_lifecycle copies the legacy tuple L field {3,4,5,6,7}; ENISA STL 2025 Annex C has no lifecycle column, so the basis is the legacy tuple, not the Annex

claims.rationale: Docking of another satellite is a proximity operation.
